candidates.title: Laurent Kabila
candidates.author: Roberto Ortiz de Zárate Arce (ed.), Fundación CIDOB
candidates.quote: Miembro de la etnia baluba, perteneciente a su vez al gran grupo bantú
candidates.supports: Supports only that a bearer of the name, Laurent-Désiré Kabila, is Luba and from Katanga (country COD). Does NOT support nameSystem clan_name, designatedSocialUnit clan or any transmission rule; the page does not discuss the name.

candidates.title: Les Baluba (Congo belge), tome II
candidates.author: R. P. Colle
candidates.quote: Voici le Kabila ka vilye, Kabila femme ou fille de l'esprit
candidates.supports: Supports only that Kabila is a Luba spirit name in 1913. Does not support a clan name; colonial source.

verifications.claim: id: PAT_BARRY; nameMain: Barry; nameSystem: clan_name; transmissionMode: patrilineal; designatedSocialUnit: clan

candidates.title: L'endogamie des Peuls du Fouta-Djallon
candidates.author: P. Cantrelle et M. Dupire
candidates.quote: la filiation s'établit par les mâles. Tout Foula dit appartenir à l'un des patriclans, Ba, Bari, So, Diallo
candidates.supports: Supports nameSystem clan_name, designatedSocialUnit clan and transmissionMode patrilineal for the Bari form of the name in the Fouta-Djalon. Does not cover Burkina Faso.

verifications.claim: id: PAT_SIDIBE; nameMain: Sidibé; nameSystem: clan_name; transmissionMode: other; designatedSocialUnit: clan

candidates.title: Identités et relations de plaisanterie chez les Peuls de l'ouest du Burkina Faso
candidates.author: Youssouf Diallo
candidates.quote: l'ensemble ethnique peul est composé de quatre clans principaux : Diallo, Diakite, Sidibe et Sangare.
candidates.supports: Supports nameSystem clan_name and designatedSocialUnit clan for Sidibé among the Fulbe of western Burkina Faso. Does not support transmissionMode: the article does not state how clan membership is transmitted. Does not cover Mali.
